_about: Photo evaluation cameras (docs/EVALUATION.md). Local frame: x east, y north, metres from the Jaffa Gate OSM node 561157424; heading compass deg (0 N, 90 E); pitch deg above horizon; fov = vertical FOV deg of the photo; z_eye = eye height above the ground under the camera. Poses fitted 2026-10-19 (GPS + EXIF + landmarks + eval_compare.py refine); expect ~1-2 m / ~1 deg error.
